resources.string: The camera opens only to scan a QR code (a contact code or a safety number) or to take a profile photo. QR images never leave your device; a photo you take is shared only if you make it your profile photo, reduced and without location or camera details, with your contacts (and, while “Show in search” is on, anyone who knows your username).
Uses your face to unlock us2us.
Your location is sent only when you share it, encrypted, to that one chat; on the live-location map your own position is shown on this device only.
The microphone is on only while you record a voice message. A recording leaves your phone only if you send it, end-to-end encrypted.
Adds a photo or video to Photos only when you choose to save it; when you save something you received, the sender sees that you saved it. It never reads your library.
